chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from Ali ibn al-Rayyan ibn al-Salt, raising it (the chain), said: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The chief of the drinks of Paradise is water.'

key_terms.الْمَاءُ: Water — the most essential and purest of all drinks
key_terms.سَيِّدُ: Chief, master, most excellent — the highest-ranked of a category
key_terms.شَرَابِ الْجَنَّةِ: The drink(s) of Paradise — all beverages found in jannah

ai.seo_question: What is the best drink in Paradise according to the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) transmits a prophetic hadith declaring water to be the foremost drink of Paradise. This tradition reflects the high spiritual status of water in Islamic thought, where it is seen not merely as a worldly necessity but as the supreme blessing of the afterlife. The original audience would have understood this as elevating the humble drink of water above all other beverages, including the rivers of wine, honey, and milk described in the Quran.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Ali Bin Al Rayyan Bin Al Salt, raising it, said, 
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The chief of the drink of the Paradise, is the water’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from Ali ibn al-Rayyan ibn al-Salt in a marfu ‘ manner who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘
The master of the drink in paradise is water.’”
